title: Headlight Bulb Replace (Education)
subtitle: Confirm housing type, then safe DIY bulb steps — no invented sizes, no root-cause certainty.
tone: Production EN lighting coach: educational, confidence language only, no root-cause certainty, no 'definitely legal' for LED upgrades, FMVSS 108 / local-law caution, max 2 CTAs.

steps.title: Confirm replaceable bulb
steps.coach_encourage: Confirming housing type first saves a wrong Amazon order.
steps.personalize: Lighting coach for your {{year}} {{make}} {{model}} at {{mileage}} miles.
steps.description: Before buying: look behind the headlamp for a twist-off dust cap and a plug-in bulb. If you only see a sealed module / heat sink with no bulb, switch to the assembly guide. Fitment varies by trim — verify on the vehicle or owner's manual.
steps.safety_warning: General guidance only. Lights can get hot — let them cool. Follow your owner's manual.
steps.safety_disclaimer: General guidance only. Follow your owner's manual or an authorized tech. This app isn't liable for DIY damage.

steps.title: Sealed path — use assembly guide
steps.coach_encourage: Stopping a wrong DIY is a win.
steps.personalize: Lighting coach for your {{year}} {{make}} {{model}} at {{mileage}} miles.
steps.description: Factory LED / sealed lamps are usually whole-assembly jobs. Open the Headlamp assembly guide, or book a qualified tech if bumper work looks heavy. Do not invent OEM lamp part numbers.
steps.safety_warning: General guidance only. Lights can get hot — let them cool. Follow your owner's manual.
steps.safety_disclaimer: General guidance only. Follow your owner's manual or an authorized tech. This app isn't liable for DIY damage.

steps.title: Power off & cool down
steps.personalize: Lighting coach for your {{year}} {{make}} {{model}} at {{mileage}} miles.
steps.description: Ignition OFF, lights OFF, keys out if practical. Let hot lamps cool. Wear gloves. Avoid touching halogen glass with bare skin — oils can create hot spots.
steps.safety_warning: Hot glass and sharp housing edges. Eye protection recommended.
steps.safety_disclaimer: General guidance only. Follow your owner's manual or an authorized tech. This app isn't liable for DIY damage.

steps.title: Access the bulb
steps.personalize: Lighting coach for your {{year}} {{make}} {{model}} at {{mileage}} miles.
steps.description: Open the dust cover. Unplug the connector (note tabs). Release the spring clip or twist lock as designed. Compare the new bulb designation to the old one and the housing/manual — do not guess H11/9005 if unlabeled.
steps.safety_warning: General guidance only. Lights can get hot — let them cool. Follow your owner's manual.
steps.safety_disclaimer: General guidance only. Follow your owner's manual or an authorized tech. This app isn't liable for DIY damage.

steps.title: Install & reseal
steps.personalize: Lighting coach for your {{year}} {{make}} {{model}} at {{mileage}} miles.
steps.description: Seat the new bulb without touching the glass. Reconnect, refit the dust cover squarely so the seal is not pinched. Moisture after a bad seal is a common DIY miss.
steps.safety_warning: General guidance only. Lights can get hot — let them cool. Follow your owner's manual.
steps.safety_disclaimer: General guidance only. Follow your owner's manual or an authorized tech. This app isn't liable for DIY damage.

steps.title: Function check & basic aim
steps.personalize: Lighting coach for your {{year}} {{make}} {{model}} at {{mileage}} miles.
steps.description: Key on: low beam, high beam, and indicators as applicable. Park ~25 ft from a wall on level ground for a rough height check — this is not a professional beam pattern calibration. If aim looks wildly off, use a shop.
steps.safety_warning: General guidance only. Lights can get hot — let them cool. Follow your owner's manual.
steps.safety_disclaimer: General guidance only. Follow your owner's manual or an authorized tech. This app isn't liable for DIY damage.

steps.title: Done — verify at night
steps.personalize: Lighting coach for your {{year}} {{make}} {{model}} at {{mileage}} miles.
steps.description: Recheck seals after the first rain. If a bulb-out warning remains on LED/CAN buses, coding or a compatible load may be shop work — we do not invent coding procedures.
steps.safety_warning: General guidance only. Lights can get hot — let them cool. Follow your owner's manual.
steps.safety_disclaimer: General guidance only. Follow your owner's manual or an authorized tech. This app isn't liable for DIY damage.
